newsitem.title: USA: Wis. wife sentenced for banishing husband to cellar.
newsitem.headline: Wis. wife sentenced for banishing husband to cellar.

text.p: A woman who banished her husband to the couple's basement for three years has been ordered to perform 100 hours of community service.

The sentence on a misdemeanor charge of battery was handed down on Monday by La Crosse County Circuit Judge Ramona Gonzalez, who said Muriel Smith, 54, was a "victim of tabloid press and a tabloid prosecution" and did not deserve to be jailed.

Initially, she was charged with felony abuse of Leroy Smith, a 64-year-old janitor, who a psychologist described as a "vulnerable adult." The complaint charged she ordered him to the cellar in 1994 after he urinated on their bedroom floor.
He was allowed only brief visits upstairs and used a seperate entrance to come and go, including a several-block walk to a convenience store to use the bathroom.
Authorities were alerted to Smith's plight by a meter reader, and the story received wide play in the media.
